decisions.result: Keep 1/14: explicitly printed in the original Japanese specifications and Finnish PDF, not 1/4.

Camera/IR modes and Calendar/VISUAL DATABANK setting screens suppress sounds; ordinary image/calendar viewing is not the stated condition. Spanish S-15 and S-39 corrected from English PDF 3/8 and Japanese PDF 9.
Approximately 60 minutes without moving the watch; Spanish S-7/S-39 aligned with English PDF 1/8 and Japanese PDF 5.
D has screen-specific destinations: Camera to VISUAL DATABANK; IR send/receive to Timekeeping. The generic after-operation return description must not override the individual procedure.
15 seconds confirmed in English PDF 3 and Japanese PDF 15. The generic one-minute setting timeout now explicitly identifies this specific case.
The 10 cm / 30 degree text, 15 degree illustration and close-distance cautions recur in other originals. No numeric limit changed.
Linked software licence, inserts, CD-ROM documentation and warranty from the contents without renumbering the original booklet.

secondPassReview.scope: Complete reread of the adapted text, contents, procedures, specifications, historical software licence and appendices. Changes were checked against the matching source procedures, not inferred from the model-cycle diagram.

corrections.change: Natural Spanish sentence for the expected years of service.
Qualified the generic D-button return rule: camera D enters VISUAL DATABANK, while IR send/receive D returns to timekeeping. Specific procedures retain precedence.
Restored the daylight recommendation; the adaptation had incorrectly generalized it to as much light as possible.
Removed an extra D press after deleting every image: D returns to timekeeping, then F enters Camera Mode. The printed correction is marked in the adapted text.
Explicitly select WATCH SEND before confirming with F, rather than relying on the initial menu selection.
